I will do this plot much like last season, because rain here can fail and I do not want to put cash into fertilizer and lose it. My maize plot is small, and for a plot like this I usually keep my own seed or seed from nearby people, then mix it with the other crop on the same land. Because the land is mine, I will carry some animal manure if I have enough, and my family will do the work ourselves.
